'''Amenar Shumada''' is a member of the [[Seanchan]] Blood.

== Appearance ==
He is long-faced.

== Activities ==
He is present when [[Tuon Athaem Kore Paendrag]] warns King [[Beslan Mitsobar]] not to cause a revolt against the Seanchan.
